title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 14: clean and unclean animals, a holy people, and the tithe.

questions.text: What were they not to do for the dead, according to Deuteronomy 14:1?
questions.explanation: As children of Yahweh they were not to cut themselves, nor make any baldness between their eyes for the dead.

answers.text: Bury them outside the city walls
Weep for them for seven days
Wear sackcloth for a full month

questions.text: Which land animals does Deuteronomy 14:6 allow them to eat?
questions.explanation: They may eat every animal that parts the hoof, has the hoof split in two and chews the cud.

answers.text: Animals that chew the cud, whatever their hoof
Animals that part the hoof, have it split in two and chew the cud
Animals that live in the fields, not the forest

questions.text: Why are the camel, the hare and the rabbit unclean?
questions.explanation: They chew the cud but don't part the hoof, so they are unclean.

answers.text: They have a split hoof but don't chew the cud
They eat the flesh of other animals
They chew the cud but don't part the hoof
They live in the dry desert

questions.text: Which animal is unclean because it has a split hoof but doesn't chew the cud?
questions.explanation: The pig has a split hoof but doesn't chew the cud, so it is unclean; they were not to eat its meat or touch its carcass.

questions.text: Which creatures in the waters may they eat?
questions.explanation: Of all that are in the waters they may eat whatever has fins and scales; whatever lacks fins and scales is unclean.

questions.text: Which of these is listed among the creatures they shall not eat?
questions.explanation: The list of what they shall not eat includes the eagle, the vulture, the owl, the pelican, the stork, the heron, the hoopoe and the bat.

questions.text: What may they do with an animal that dies of itself?
questions.explanation: They shall not eat it, but may give it to the foreigner within their gates or sell it to a foreigner.

answers.text: Give or sell it to a foreigner

questions.text: Complete Deuteronomy 14:21: "You shall not boil a young goat in ..."
questions.explanation: The verse ends: "You shall not boil a young goat in its mother's milk."

questions.text: What were they to do with their tithe if the chosen place was too far to carry it?
questions.explanation: They were to turn it into money, go to the place Yahweh chooses, and trade the money there for whatever they desired.

answers.text: Give it to the poor at home

questions.text: How often were they to bring all the tithe of that year and store it within their gates?
questions.explanation: At the end of every three years they were to store the tithe within their gates, so that the Levite, foreigner, fatherless and widow could eat and be satisfied.

answers.text: At the end of every seven years
At the end of every three years
